critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/billing/subscribe + /api/billing/portal correctly gate on _is_real_stripe_key() and return 501 with a helpful message when STRIPE_API_KEY == 'sk_test_emergent'. Code path for real keys is fully wired (Customer, Subscription metadata, trial_period_days, native webhook handler) and will activate the moment a real sk_live_/sk_test_ key is dropped into backend/.env.
/api/billing/info exposes {uses_real_stripe} so the frontend can route between /billing/subscribe (real Stripe recurring) and /billing/checkout (Emergent one-time) without backend changes.
compute_level() uses a clean quadratic curve (100*n*(n-1)); 440 XP -> level 2 with 160 XP to next level — verified live.
_recommend_path() routes beginner -> fundamentals first, then focus, then goal — matches spec; verified live via 3 quiz combos.
_issue_certificate_if_complete is idempotent (queries certs_col first); confirmed via re-completing final fundamentals lesson returns certificates_issued=[].
Certificate serial format ASC-{path[:4].upper()}-{6hex} is unique enough but technically not collision-proof; acceptable for current scale.
MongoDB ObjectId is correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} everywhere — no serialization issues observed.
/api/certificates/{id} scopes by user_id in the query (cannot read other users' certs) — verified returns 404 for random IDs.
Frontend onboarding flow correctly calls PUT /api/auth/me/quiz immediately after signup so quiz_answers + recommended_path_id are persisted — verified via /api/auth/me on the new user.
